Looking for a cozy and convenient place to call home? This is your chance to rent a charming bedroom in a 3 bed / 1.5 bath house located in Highland Park. The room is on the smaller side but the house is so big that you'll have plenty of space to relax and work without feeling cramped. Massive front and back yards both of which have ample seating for hosting or working (wifi extenders reach both sides). The location is ~unparalleled~, a 7 minute walk to the bars / shops on 56th and Fig, and a 12 minute walk to Holcomb wine bar on York and all of those fun spots.
The house features a large living room with a TV and fireplace, a big dining room, and a nice kitchen with new appliances, including a dishwasher and two full-sized fridges. We also have a laundry room in the house and basement for storage. It comes with a parking spot on a long driveway with the ability to tandem park a car behind you when you have guests (must park close together). Outside, there's a giant backyard with tons of furniture where you can unwind and enjoy our 100 year old tree and bougainvilleas.
The room is available from 6/1/2025 and is open for a six month lease with a possible opportunity to extend.  One wall is just south-facing windows, providing ample natural light and great breeze plus you have an AC/heater that you control (each room has their own device). The house is fully furnished, so all you need to bring is your bedroom furniture. The room comes with a ½ of a small office / guest room. The roommates all share the room when we occasionally have guests, but all other times it's available to be used by you as an office or storage / yoga space / extra clothing rack.
About us: Two gals looking for a roommate who is organized, clean, and a good direct communicator. Clare is 30 and is in her 2nd year of medical school but swears she is mostly normal, love to DIY, eat, cook, and have tea with Caillin. Caillin is 31, a writer, sourdough bread maker, and all around great person to be around (this was written by Clare). We are a shoes-off household and don't leave dishes in the sink for more than a day. We also do weekly deep cleans (one person is floors, one is kitchen, and the other is bathrooms) and have a cleaner once a month.
Rent is $1,400 per month plus utilities

description:

Perched above the historic Monterey Road Pass in the cozy hillside neighborhood of Hermon, this updated and remodeled home offers scenic views and tranquil living. Tucked between Arroyo Seco, Monterey Hills, Highland Park, and South Pasadena, you’ll find a hidden gem that blends peaceful seclusion with easy city access. Brick-lined stairs lead to a charming composite front deck, perfect for morning coffee or evening sunsets with views stretching across Hermon and the Monterey Hills. Entering through the front door, the living room welcomes you with engineered hardwood flooring and dual-pane windows that fill the space with natural light. The layout flows into a dining area and a thoughtfully updated kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances—including a gas range, dishwasher, microwave, and fridge—and easy-to-clean linoleum flooring. Down the hall, both bedrooms are comfortably sized and feature lighted ceiling fans and generous closets. The first bathroom boasts tile flooring, a dual-sink vanity with river rock countertops, and a custom-tiled shower stall with a rain shower head and matching river rock floors. At the end of the hall is a second full bathroom with sleek black hex tile, a deep soaking tub with oversized subway tile walls, a rain shower head, handheld shower head, and a stylish single-sink vanity. A brand-new stackable washer and dryer is conveniently tucked away here too. Out back, the home extends into a multi-level outdoor oasis. A wood deck off the kitchen makes for a great dining or lounge spot, leading up to a terraced hillside landscaped with lush greenery. The middle terrace offers a patch of artificial grass, market lights, and multiple spots to entertain or relax. Climb a bit higher and you’ll find a quiet seating area at the top—ideal for taking in panoramic views of the hills and skyline. Backed up against Ernest E. Debs Regional Park and with quick access to Rose Hill Park, Hermon Park, Downtown LA, and Dodger Stadium via the Arroyo Seco Parkway, this hillside retreat offers both charm and convenience in one of Northeast LA’s best-kept secrets.

Serrano Homesite Trail leads to the property...
This trail travels through Serrano Valley in Point Mugu State Park, the westernmost park of the Santa Monica Mountains. This area is pretty isolated and not well-known so chances are you'll be the only one on it. Nearby Circle X Ranch and the trails of Boney Mountain have more visitors. You will enjoy a peaceful and easy 1.4-mile walk through a rolling grassland meadow with Boney Mountain and Boney Peak in the backdrop. At the homestead site you will get to view old farm equipment and other household items, including the kitchen sink.
There are two natural waterfalls on the property and a year long creek.
Imagine riding out each morning and evening into a sacred valley virtually hidden protected from the hustle bustle of modern life, yes it exists! Because of the location within Serrano Valley there is absolutely no traffic noise...
Imagine living in one of the most beautiful parks in the state and yet be able to drive 34 miles to be in Santa Monica and 43 miles to Wilshire Boulevard via PCH (Highway 1).

The Location
We're in Brentwood, blocks away from the San Vicente Blvd strip, which is full of great restaurants, cafes, bars, groceries, and shopping. Brentwood is great in general because it's one of the only areas of LA where the other popular neighborhoods are all in easy reach- like Santa Monica, Venice, Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, and Westwood. Especially because we're near both the 405 and the 10 leading in all directions, so we don't have to fight much street traffic to hop on the freeway.

The room's offered on a monthly basis that can either be short-term or go longterm. The room is furnished, and the rest of the house is furnished, so you're taken care of there. Parking

Us
We generally work in "professional-type" careers. We're social, clean, respectful, responsible, laid-back, and easy to get along/live with. We typically keep it low-key on weeknights- occasional dinner, happy hour, gym, catch up on errands. We like to be out and about on weekend days and out socially weekend nights, but without bringing the party home. Sometimes we may casually hangout with our roommates here and there, but sometimes everyone's busy with their own lives, either way works! We're non-smoking, no drama, and into health/fitness/wellness.
You
Same sort of description above in terms of clean, respectful, responsible, laid-back, easy to get along with, etc. Obviously able to pay rent always on time. Pretty much a normal person! Sorry but no smoking inside the house, no couples, and no pets.
Thanks!
